sections.value:
At this compact, performance/320 and performance/322 remain held; #314/#317/#318/#321 holdings are released. Do not reclaim released instances or release an open instance just because directory Next actions recommends fewer holds (F272, PM instruction).

Published cost verdicts: #320 R1 a69acfd at 5c219c0b34c1f2e3e2253e68bbf96f8fca1a9631; #322 R1 ef8819e at c0cae51578ca534b23e7fa3e0ca43fe1b7d5dff9. Both PASS-WITH-NOTES. For durable cost details open f268-rate-and-retry-cost and f270-release-expiry-cost rather than repeating their investigations. Mongoose confirmed #320 failed-renewal/second-expiry correctness witnesses; the cost pass never cleared those. Await PM exact-head follow-up packets.

Still owed after the shared #318/#321 deployment: verify marten’s #321 thread-CPU/whoami receipts, keeping #318 observer/capture effects separate. Marten announced daemon PID96429, two 90s windows, receipt destination /tmp/f258-receipts/pool-after-96429.json. That file/result has NOT been read or verified by this seat. The announced approximately 01:01–01:04 local windows on November 22, 2026 are later than this 00:52 compact request: treat the notice as provisional, not completed AFTER proof. Read completed receipts, pin deployment/process and cohorts, then publish a governed AFTER note; the pool-lease-worker-cost note owns comparison limits.

All #322 release migration runs and row/quick_check verification completed after revival. Owned DB copies and sidecars were removed; reproducible probes and logs remain in this session’s files/pr322-* artifacts. No review build or probe is left running by this seat.

Lesson: an announced receipt path is not a receipt. Preserve completion status and ownership across compaction so future holders do not turn a planned/running measurement into verified evidence.
